report.summary: Compared to last week: Feeder steers over 750lbs steady to 3.00 higher, under 750lbs 5.00-10.00 higher.
report.narrative: Compared to last week: Feeder steers over 750lbs steady to 3.00 higher, under 750lbs 5.00-10.00 higher. Feeder heifers 2.00-7.00 higher. Steer calves 10.00-20.00 higher. Heifers calves over 500lbs 4.00-8.00 higher, under 500lbs 10.00-20.00 higher. Demand good for all classes of cattle. Quality average. Most feeders were coming off grass and condition was in the buyer's favor. Buyers reported an increase in orders as wheat has emerged across the trading area, with additional rainfall forecasted throughout the remainder of the week.

report.summary: A limited number of comparable offerings from last weeks a trend will not be given.
report.narrative: A limited number of comparable offerings from last weeks a trend will not be given. Today's auction started the day with Feeders off grass, pregged checked open heifers then onto Fall calves and finished up the auction with Spring calves. Demand was moderate to good with active internet bidding. Next Auction Date Oct 16th 23rd & 30th Spring Calf and Feeder Auctions

report.summary: A limited number of comparable offerings from last week, a trend will not be given, for Spring calves.
report.narrative: A limited number of comparable offerings from last week, a trend will not be given, for Spring calves. Yearling offerings of steers 900 and 1000 lbs traded 3.00 higher. Demand was good with several buyers and active internet bidding for the consigned offerings. Next Auction Dates: Oct 21st Special Bred Cow and Pairs, Oct 28th Special Feeder Cattle Auction

report.summary: Compared to last week, steer and heifer calves sold with a lower undertone.
report.narrative: Compared to last week, steer and heifer calves sold with a lower undertone. Demand was mostly moderate, instances good from in house buyers with an active internet. Bulk of the trade sold in packages throughout the day. Majority of the calves had fall precondition shots. For the few lots that only had spring vaccination protocol a steep discount was applied by the buyers. Some nice packages of preg checked open heifers off area ranchers replacements in the run.
Compared to last week. Steers10.00 to 20.00 lower. Heifers 15.00 to 25.00 lower. Quality was plain to average with a moderate trade with heavy rain most of the day.

report.summary: Trade activity and demand was good.
report.narrative: Trade activity and demand was good. Dairy heifers traded mostly 1.00 to 4.00 higher. Average dress slaughter cows traded 1.00 to 4.00 higher, while average dress slaughter bulls traded 1.00-2.00 higher. Next available report will be Thursday, October 22, 2026.

method: Herd Planner's price model: the hub market (Oklahoma City) plus each barn's own measured difference from it; the range is where 8 in 10 real sales fell when the model was tested on sales it never saw.
